text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — Canary probe failure: `canary-eu-west-1` (check: synthetic-liveness). PD key: PD-ABCD1234. See: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-ABCD1234

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-ABCD1234 created (severity: P1 -> auto). Triggering runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/canary-failures

sam oncall: acked. I'm on it.

mike_sre: seeing repeated 502/504 from the canary agent to model-router in eu-west-1. 5xx rate ~18% over last 5m.

april_pm: any customer-facing errors?

sam oncall: initial health checks show only synthetic probes failing. No alerts from product services yet, but latency on embeddings proxy climbed earlier. Holding until we confirm if it's probe-only.

cj_eng: pulled the logs from canary-prober-0: 
```
2026-03-14T06:40:21Z ERROR canary check failed: upstream timeout (client=10.12.4.22)
2026-03-14T06:40:22Z WARN retrying request (attempt 3)
2026-03-14T06:40:23Z ERROR canary check failed: upstream 502 Bad Gateway
```

cj_eng: also noticing `model-router` CPU spiked on that node around 06:39 UTC. Could be transient overload.

emily_support: fyi — we got one customer message at 06:45 UTC about slow embeddings, ticket #SUP-732. They reported 503s for ~2min.

mike_sre: good catch. I'll query infra metrics. `sum(rate(router_request_errors_total[5m])) by (region)` shows a spike in eu-west-1 matching probe times.

runbook-bot: Suggested mitigation step 1: restart canary-prober deployment. Step 2 (if persists): failover traffic or scale model-router. Link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/canary-failures#mitigation

sam oncall: running restart: 
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/canary-prober-eu-west-1
```

sam oncall: rollout restarted. pods cycling. monitoring logs.

cj_eng: while prober restarts, can we check node-level pressure? `kubectl top nodes` shows one node at 98% CPU in eu-west-1. Might need to cordon/evict.

april_pm: if this is causing customer 503s we should escalate. What's the blast radius?

emily_support: only 2 support tickets so far (one internal test, one customer). Not widespread but time-correlated.

mike_sre: I'm increasing replicas for `model-router-eu` to soak some traffic: `kubectl scale deployment/model-router-eu --replicas=6 -n infra` — doing now.

cj_eng: I'm preparing a cordon/drain on the hot node: `kubectl cordon node-az3-eu-west-1` then `kubectl drain node-az3-eu-west-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — holding until scaling finishes.

sam oncall: ack. If scaling takes >3m we escalate to infra infra-oncall.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-ABCD1234 acknowledged by sam oncall at 1827501260.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation policy check: auto-escalate in 5m if unacked by infra.

april_pm: tagging support/ops for customer comms prep in case we see more tickets.

emily_support: drafted a short status for customers: "We are investigating intermittent 5xx errors for embeddings in eu-west-1; no widespread outages reported. We'll update within 15 minutes."

mike_sre: replicas scaled to 6, CPU spread looks better. error rate dropping to ~4% now.

cj_eng: drain started on node-az3-eu-west-1. Pods are rescheduling.

sam oncall: metrics greening. synthetic checks are now passing in rolling windows (3/3 successful runs).

runbook-bot: Automatic check: canary success rate >95% for 2 consecutive windows -> consider resolved.

sam oncall: handing off to mike_sre for post-restart monitoring and postmortem. Handoff note: restarted canary prober, scaled model-router, drained hot node. Observed customer impact limited (1 confirmed ticket).

mike_sre: taking over. Will keep watching dashboards for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: PD-ABCD1234 status changed to `acknowledged` and assigned to mike_sre.

cj_eng: quick timeline for postmortem: root cause candidate = single node CPU pressure leading to router timeouts, which caused probe failures and a small number of customer-facing 503s. Follow-ups: adjust probe threshold, add proactive node autoscaling, and increase router replica buffer. I'll own the autoscaling PR.

april_pm: assign owner for customer communication follow-up? emily_support will follow through.

emily_support: will send follow-up to affected customer and update ticket.

incident-bot: Automated resolution check passed. Marking incident as resolved. PD incident PD-ABCD1234 -> resolved at 1827501989.

sam oncall: resolving here — closing thread. Follow-ups: 
- cj_eng: autoscaler PR (owner)
- mike_sre: postmortem draft (24h)
- emily_support: customer update (ASAP)

april_pm: thanks all. Good rapid response. :thumbsup:
